ambiguities_or_notes: Exact audited Russian Markdown source bytes were revalidated in this runtime against the pinned SHA-256.
All four printed page markers, the complete 21 March diary body, both Latin passages, and all twenty-one notes are represented.
решения дел должны быть народны is rendered judgments in cases ought to be public, in the surrounding context of republican/open adjudication; no broader institutional claim is added.
The source's accusatory/criminal terminology is kept close to Tolstoy's wording even where modern legal English would distinguish accused, defendant, and convicted offender more sharply.
All deleted variants, including the reversal innocent/guilty recorded by note 13, remain in the apparatus rather than being silently normalized.
